name: charge_full
for: hero (wayfarer) charged heavy attack: plays once the moment the charge is full (1 s held), over the looping charge_gather or replacing it for these frames
anchor_note: anchor_px = the star's core; same place as charge_gather's core (the hands/hilt). The canvas runs further below the core than above because the thrown sparks fall
notes: Frame 0 the core swells into a small star; frames 1-2 a hand-pixeled 8-point star at full size (63 px = about 1.0 m tip to tip at 64 px/m: white core, 1-px main rays tapering from 3 px at the root, diagonal rays shorter, every ray fading from white to warm gold at the tip) while 14 short spark streaks and 5 embers burst out and arc down; frames 3-7 the star shrinks back to a small cross matching charge_gather's core. 0.67 s, 7 colours, no outline, no dither. The star is a drawn image strip (uploaded as the effect's projectile picture), so it is in these files but not stored with the My effects copy.
